title: Cauliflower Schnitzel
subtitle: crumbed and deep fried
description: Whole cauliflowers are boiled, sliced into thick steaks, then battered, crumbed and fried. Serve with cashew cream or amba.

steps.text: Bring plenty of salted water to the boil in 2 large pots that can hold the cauliflowers whole. Boil them for about 12 minutes until tender but not falling apart. Cool, then slice each cauliflower into 3 thick slices.
Heat the oil for deep frying in a pot over medium heat for about 8 minutes.
Whisk the flour, iced water and spices in a bowl into a smooth batter. Mix the breadcrumbs on a wide plate.
Dip the cauliflower slices in the batter, then coat both sides in breadcrumbs and fry for about 3 minutes. Turn and fry for another 3-4 minutes.
Drain on a plate lined with paper towel and serve with cashew cream or amba.
